policy: Primary papers and official framework documentation; no measured model/GPU performance is claimed.

sources.title: LoRA original paper, v2
checks: Frozen W0 and factorized update; alpha/r scaling; random A and zero B; low-rank adaptation is empirical, not universal equivalence.

sources.title: PiSSA original paper, v1 (2024)
checks: Principal singular components initialize trainable factors, frozen residual reconstructs W0 at initialization; translate paper AB naming to this chapter BA naming.

sources.title: PEFT v0.21.0 LoRA reference
checks: Default Kaiming-uniform A and zero B; rsLoRA alpha/sqrt(r); DoRA magnitude/direction; PiSSA initial-component subtraction when converting to ordinary LoRA; merge versus dynamic adapters and implementation-specific support.

derivedChecks: Two factor gradients and double-zero stall follow the chain rule under stated standard-parameterization assumptions.
PiSSA scaled residual and delta-from-original identities are checked with deterministic algebra fixtures.
Cache version isolation is a conservative serving condition, not a claim that every architecture makes all old cache entries incompatible.
limits: No general superiority claims or paper benchmark numbers copied.
No installed PEFT version or GPU training environment is claimed.
Wordings retain original unique content; checks narrowly verify uncertain initialization, scaling, variant and deployment claims.
